name: Active Directory Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Active Directory environments. Covers domain enumeration, Group Policy analysis, Kerberos attacks (Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, delegation abuse), ACL analysis, trust relationship assessment, certificate services (AD CS) attacks, and privilege escalation paths within AD forests.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Active Directory security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Active Directory architecture, authentication protocols, and common attack patterns
evidence: Can explain AD forests, domains, trusts, and organizational units
Understands Kerberos and NTLM authentication at a conceptual level
Familiar with common AD attack techniques (pass-the-hash, Kerberoasting)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs AD enumeration and basic attack path analysis under supervision
evidence: Runs AD enumeration tools (e.g., BloodHound, PowerView, ADRecon) under guidance
Identifies overly permissive ACLs and Group Policy misconfigurations using checklists
Documents AD security findings with supervision; work reviewed by authorized personnel

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses AD security posture and identifies privilege escalation paths
evidence: Independently performs comprehensive AD enumeration and attack path analysis
Identifies Kerberos delegation, ACL abuse, and trust misconfiguration risks
Assesses AD CS configurations for certificate-based privilege escalation
Produces compliant AD security assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-forest assessments; discovers novel attack paths; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex multi-forest environments with external and cross-forest trusts
Develops custom tooling for AD attack path discovery and exploitation
Reviews AD assessment work of junior analysts
Demonstrates advanced techniques (AD CS abuse, shadow credentials, DACL manipulation)

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab AD assessment methodology; publishes research on AD attack techniques
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's AD security assessment framework
Published research on novel AD attack techniques or defense bypass methods
Trains teams on advanced Active Directory security assessment
Recognized as internal or external authority on AD security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a deliberately misconfigured AD environment and achieve domain admin through multiple independent attack paths
Review AD assessment findings from recent engagements for completeness and accuracy

cis: CIS Microsoft Windows Server Benchmark - Domain Controller (DC only) recommendations
